mentions.name: Victorian Research Institution Management Game
mentions.description: A management game about turning chaotic fields of research into fundable products, conceptually 'what if Theme Hospital was about a Victorian-esque research institution instead of a hospital?'. Players hire strange scientists who explore dangerous, unstable research domains, collecting messy findings that get turned into theories, prototypes, and eventually products. The game loop has two parts: Exploration/Discovery, where the player manages the institution's funding, equipment, research direction, and safety while scientists delve deeper (compared to Kerbal Space Program focused on Mission Control rather than the astronauts), and Exhibition, where investors visit to see discoveries and prototypes and decide whether to provide more funding or grants. Players must keep producing exciting new discoveries to keep investors interested while inventing tools to delve deeper.
